acceptance_criteria.criterion: composer test produces 0 PHPUnit test runner warnings
All 315 tests pass with no failures
All test files under tests/testsuites/ (excluding already-correct files) use the MailcodeTests\{Suite}[\{SubDir}] namespace pattern
declare(strict_types=1) is present in all modified files

summary: Standardised 136 test files across 16 directories. 113 files renamed to *Tests.php, 23 already-named files had namespaces corrected. All files now use MailcodeTests\{Suite}[\{SubDir}] namespace pattern.

PHP automation script (fix-tests.php) processed: (1) adding declare(strict_types=1), (2) inserting/correcting namespace declarations, (3) renaming classes to {BasenameWithoutExt}Tests, (4) adding 'use MailcodeTestCase;' imports, (5) renaming files.
Result: 0 PHPUnit warnings (was 113), 519 tests pass (was 315 — 204 previously invisible tests now execute properly). HubL directory untouched.

comments.note: The automation script inserted declare(strict_types=1) and namespace lines with double blank lines between them in some files due to regex replacement sequencing. Extra blank lines are cosmetic and do not affect functionality, but a formatter pass (e.g., php-cs-fixer) would tighten style. Affects all 113 renamed+fixed files.
Translator/Velocity/BreakTests.php previously had a typo in the class name ('Translator_Velocity_BreeakTests' with double 'e'). The rename to BreakTests.php corrected this silently. No test impact.

phpunit.xml uses deprecated PHPUnit 13 attributes (convertErrorsToExceptions, convertNoticesToExceptions, convertWarningsToExceptions) causing the PHPUnit deprecation notice in every test run. Pre-existing issue unrelated to WP-001, should be fixed in a maintenance pass.

summary: All 5 acceptance criteria verified against live code.
519 tests pass (0 failures, 1 incomplete pre-existing, 1 PHPUnit deprecation pre-existing from phpunit.xml).
Zero test runner warnings. All 176 test files end in *Tests.php, all use MailcodeTests\{Suite}[\{SubDir}] namespace, all contain declare(strict_types=1).
Class-to-filename alignment confirmed via direct grep — false positives from 'final class' keyword in edge-case check ruled out manually.

comments.note: AC-2 stated 'All 315 tests pass' but the implementation expanded the visible test count from 315 to 519 by fixing namespaces. The criterion is met: all tests pass. Future WPs should update the baseline to 519.

1 incomplete test (I marker) and 1 PHPUnit Deprecation from phpunit.xml deprecated XML attributes are pre-existing issues unrelated to WP-001 changes — flagged by Developer in implementation pipeline.

Edge-case check: 'final class' pattern in shell grep caused apparent MISMATCH reports; confirmed by direct grep inspection that class names correctly match filenames in all surveyed files. No autoloading issues found.

summary: Code review passed. All 519 tests pass (0 failures, 0 warnings). Every test file in testsuites/ satisfies: MailcodeTests\{Suite}[\{SubDir}] namespace, *Tests.php filename, declare(strict_types=1), and correct base-class resolution via 'use MailcodeTestCase;' import.
HubL directory verified untouched. LogicKeywords (unlisted in WP table) correctly processed. No old underscore-prefixed class names remain. No files missing strict_types or namespace.

Two pre-existing non-blocking issues confirmed: phpunit.xml deprecated attributes (1 per-run deprecation notice) and cosmetic double-blank-lines in auto-patched file headers. No blocking issues found.

comments.note: Base-class resolution: WP spec called for '\MailcodeTestCase' backslash prefix, but the implementation used 'use MailcodeTestCase;' import + bare extends. Both are valid PHP; the import approach is more readable. Tests confirm correctness.

File-header blank lines are inconsistent across the corpus: some files emit '<?php


declare(...)' (double blank) while others emit '<?php

declare(...)' (single blank). Cosmetic only — a php-cs-fixer pass in a future maintenance ticket would normalize this.
LogicKeywords/ directory was not listed in the WP affected-directories table but was correctly processed (KeywordTests.php verified: namespace MailcodeTests\LogicKeywords, strict_types present).

AC-2 baseline drift: the acceptance criterion states '315 tests pass' but the fix exposed 204 previously-invisible tests, raising the count to 519. The criterion is marked met (all tests pass), but future WPs must use 519 as the baseline test count.

Pre-existing phpunit.xml deprecated attributes (convertErrorsToExceptions etc.) cause 1 PHPUnit Deprecation notice per run. Unrelated to WP-001; should be resolved in a dedicated maintenance WP targeting PHPUnit 13 compatibility.
